# agenco_identity_configuration (Resource)

Manages the vendor's identity configuration. This is a singleton for the whole vendor, so declare it at most once. The API has no delete route, so destroying the resource only drops it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Vendor-wide singleton — declare it at most once across your configuration.
resource "agenco_identity_configuration" "default" {
  default_token_expiration = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_token_expiration` (Number) Default access-token lifetime in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identity configuration ID.
